standing_order: Find the level exit alive, fast: keep moving into ground not yet walked, open every door, press the exit switch. After turning away from a wall, keep committing to that side only while it keeps opening into new or unexplored ground; once it hits a wall again or its ground is already walked, pick a different offered direction instead of doubling back. If ahead is blocked and the remaining offered directions are all already-walked ground, do not alternate between them tick to tick — keep the same heading you just committed to for a few more steps before trying yet another direction, since switch

instructions.question: Which of the offered directions should the player go now? Each option is a direction around the player, with what the map says there under `now`.
instructions.focus: Prefer the exit direction first, then ground marked unexplored (never seen) — strictly over ground merely marked new — then a door in that direction at arm's length or on the way/close (doors reliably lead to new territory, so treat a close door as high priority, not a last resort), then long or open space with new ground. Avoid picking 'behind' unless every other offered direction is blocked or already walked: behind is always ground the player just came from, and picking it repeatedly causes backtracking loops. When every offered direction is already-walked ground (no unexplored, new ground, or door on offer), do not just alternate between the two least-bad options tick after tick — pick o

direction.what: go {dir}: best when the exit, key or ground_hint lies {dir}, or its ground is unexplored (never seen), or a door (at arm's length or on the way/close) lies {dir}, or its space is long or open with new ground
direction.not_for: its ground was already walked while another offered direction is unexplored, new, or has a door; repeating the side just turned away from once that side is now blocked or its ground has become walked; a small tight offshoot of merely 'new' ground when a door lies in another offered direction; and choosing 'behind' unless ahead, left and right are all blocked or already fully walked — behind is always ground you just came from, so it should be a last resort, not a default.
examples: {dir}: a door on the way, close

instructions.question: Should the player walk forward right now?

true.what: surroundings.ahead.space is open or tight, or a door or the exit switch is at arm's length ahead (walk up to it)

false.what: surroundings.ahead.space is blocked by a wall, bars, a barrier, a barrel or a monster at point blank, or the player is stuck
examples: ahead blocked, a wall at arm's length
ahead blocked, a barrier at arm's length

instructions.question: Is there something to operate at arm's length ahead?

true.what: a door, the exit switch or a locked door is at arm's length ahead, or the player is stuck (try the wall)
examples: the exit switch at arm's length

false.what: nothing near, or a plain wall, bars, a barrier or a monster ahead

true.what: combat.enemy_in_crosshair is yes and player.equipped_ammo is more than zero

false.what: no enemy in the crosshair, or equipped ammunition is zero

Dodge left.what: combat.threat is danger and surroundings.left is open

Dodge right.what: combat.threat is danger, left not open, surroundings.right open

Dodge back.what: combat.threat is danger, sides not open, surroundings.behind open

instructions.question: Turn to put the enemy in the crosshair. Where is it now?

Fine left.what: slightly left or just left of the crosshair

Fine right.what: slightly right or just right of the crosshair

Keep.what: whatever weapon is currently equipped (check player.equipped_weapon) still has ammunition left for it — stay on it regardless of which weapon it is

Pistol.what: shotgun shells are zero and pistol bullets remain

Shotgun.what: owns a shotgun with shells and the pistol is currently equipped

Kill enemies.what: an enemy visible at close or mid range, health not critical, ammunition ready

Restore health.what: health critical, or low with a health pickup seen close and no close enemy
Restore health.not_for: a health pickup that sits behind a wall or otherwise requires backtracking through already-walked ground to reach; the path toward it is currently blocked by a wall at point-blank range (treat it as unreachable for now, not worth pursuing); or a pickup already approached repeatedly without getting any closer — prefer Explore instead in all of these cases, since chasing an unreachable pickup just produces a back-and-forth loop

Stock ammo.what: ammunition empty or scarce and an ammo pickup seen close

Add armor.what: armor none, an armor pickup seen close and reachable straight ahead or to a side by a clear, open or tight path with no wall in between, health fine, no close enemy, exit not seen yet
Add armor.not_for: the armor pickup sits behind a wall or otherwise requires backtracking through already-walked ground to reach; the path ahead toward it is currently blocked by a wall at point-blank range (treat it as unreachable for now, not worth pursuing); or a pickup already circled toward repeatedly without getting closer — prefer Explore instead in all of these cases

Explore.what: otherwise: keep exploring toward new ground and the exit, favoring ground never seen over ground already walked, to avoid re-treading the same loop
examples: no enemy, health fine, exit not seen
